_doc: Allowed values for classified fields in records/. Specification: docs/50_process/520_record-keeping.md. Add a value here, with a one-line meaning, before using it. From session S07, task_type is the subject of the work and activity is what was done (author's ruling, S07-001); the three task types listed in _task_type_as_activity are activities and may not be used as task_type from S07 on.

actor.A: the agentic layer: a language model choosing and composing (ADR-0010)
actor.D: deterministic machinery: output fully determined by a program given its inputs

role.propose: offers options, findings or drafts for someone else to decide
role.check: verifies work done by a step

work_class.maintain: needed merely to keep the existing landscape or apparatus working (CON-OP-16 counterfactual)
work_class.rework: redoes something because it was wrong
work_class.explore: looks for options without yet building

task_type.repo-maintenance: keeping the repository and its tooling working
task_type.research: reading outside material to answer a question
task_type.source-discovery: finding and assessing candidate data sources
task_type.matching: proposing or testing identity and keys across sources
task_type.generation: producing code or artefacts from designs
task_type.review: cross-model or human review of drafted material
task_type.adjudication: a person ruling on a proposed claim
task_type.analysis: answering a business question from data
task_type.documentation: writing design documents, ADRs, register rows
task_type.communication: reporting to or asking the author

blocker.robots: robots.txt or equivalent disallows automated access
blocker.session-limit: the tool environment's own usage limit
blocker.network: network path not available from this environment
blocker.tool-missing: no tool can do it here
blocker.information-missing: a fact needed is not available

defect.wrong-link: a reference points at the wrong target
defect.unflagged-assumption: a claim stated as fact without a source or an unverified flag
defect.overreach: goes beyond what the evidence or mandate supports
defect.process-breach: a repository convention was not followed
defect.tool-error: a tool returned a wrong or misleading result

ts_precision.exact: from a clock or a message timestamp
ts_precision.approx: estimated to within a few minutes
ts_precision.bound: only an earlier-or-later bound is known

recorded.contemporaneous: written at or just after the step
recorded.same-session-reconstruction: written later in the same session, from the transcript

human_basis._superseded: superseded 2026-09-25 by the author's ruling not to record his time; kept for old records only

source_status.acquired: data obtained and stored under data/
source_status.rejected: considered and ruled out; reason given
source_status.blocked: wanted but not obtainable yet; reason given

human_activity.answer: replies in the conversation; size small
human_activity.approve: approves a permission prompt or similar; size small
human_activity.act: acts in the real world for the model: downloads, installs, logs in, fetches, moves files; size large

human_size.large: being the model's hands in the real world (author's ruling, 2026-09-25)

validation_status.validated: a check by a different agent confirmed the output
validation_status.failed: a check by a different agent rejected the output

work_reason.first-pass: doing it for the first time

defect_severity.low: cosmetic or easily noticed; no wrong conclusion
defect_severity.medium: could mislead a reader or waste work
defect_severity.high: would produce a wrong result or decision if unnoticed
defect_severity.critical: a wrong result or decision was acted on

detected_stage.self-check: found by the step's own agent
detected_stage.review: found by a cross-model or peer review
detected_stage.author: found by the author
detected_stage.downstream: found by later work that depended on it
detected_stage.audit: found by the blind session-close audit

check_type.reconciliation: agreement with another source or total

asset_kind.source-file: a file as delivered by a source
asset_kind.model: a data model or vault structure

activity.document: writing design documents, ADRs, register rows, notes
activity.acquire: obtaining data, by download or copy
